title: 第10章 离心异梦
content_zh:
秦英豪想到当年力战大化三鬼的情景，嘴角上不自禁出现了一丝笑意，然而这是愁苦中的一丝微笑，是伤心中一闪即逝的欢欣。于是他想到腿伤愈后，与方玲结成夫妇，那个刻骨铭心、倾心相爱的妻子，就是眼前这个美妇。她在身前不过五尺，这五尺却比五千里、五万里的路程更加遥远。

    于是他想到两人新婚后那段欢乐的日子，他带着娇妻一同去拜祭闵恩仇、范知悦夫妇，见坟墓坏处修整好了，他把龙雀宝刀封在坟前地下土中，心想：“世上除了闵恩仇，再也没人配用这口宝刀。他既不在世上了，宝刀就该陪着他。要是他仍在世上，自己自会双手奉刀，送了给他，然后和他相对痛饮，尽醉方休。”

    在闵恩仇的墓前，他把当年这场比武与误伤的经过说给妻子听。他从来不爱多说话，这一天却是说得滔滔不绝。这件事在他心中郁积了十年，直到今天，才在最亲近的人面前发泄出来。他办了许多酒菜来祭奠闵恩仇，摆满了一桌，就像当年闵夫人在他们比武时做了一桌菜那样。

    于是他喝了不少酒，好像这位生平唯一的知己复活了，与他一起欢谈畅饮。他愈喝得多，愈说得多。说了如何用北斗刀法打败大化三鬼，从刀法说到对这位闵刀王的钦佩与崇仰，说到造化弄人，人世无常，说到闵夫人对丈夫的情爱，他说：“像这样的女人，要是丈夫在水里，她一定也在水里，丈夫在火里，她也在火里……”

    突然，看到妻子脸色变了，掩着脸远远奔开……他追上去想要解释，但他醉了，他不会说话，何况，他心中确是记得旅馆中三鬼火攻的那一幕……他是在火里，而她却独自先逃了出去……

    他一生慷慨豪侠，素来不理会小节，然而这是他生死以之相爱的人……在他脑子里，一直觉得方玲应该逃出去，她是女人，不会半点武功，见到了浓烟烈火自然害怕，她那时又不是他妻子，陪着他死了，又有什么好处？但在心里，他深深盼望在自己遇到危难时，有个心爱的人守在身旁，盼望心爱的人不要弃他而先逃……他一直羡慕闵恩仇有个真心相爱的夫人，自己可没有。闵恩仇虽然早死，这一生却比自己过得快活。

    酒醉后，在闵恩仇墓前无意中说错一句话，也可说是无意中流露了真心。这句话造成了夫妻间永难弥补的裂痕。虽然，秦英豪始终极深厚极诚挚地爱着妻子。

    他永远不再提到这件事，甚至连闵恩仇的名字也不提，方玲自然也不会提。

    后来女儿秦佳茵出生了，像母亲一般的美丽，像母亲一般的娇嫩，夫妻间的感情也加深了一层。然而，他是出身草莽的江湖豪杰，妻子却是位公家千金。他天性沉默寡言，整天板着脸，妻子却需要温柔体贴、低声下气的安慰。她要男人风雅斯文、懂得女人的小性儿，要男人会说笑、会调情……秦英豪空有一身打遍天下无敌手的武功，妻子所要的一切却全没有。如果方玲会武功，有一点江湖豪气，或许会佩服丈夫的本事，会懂得他为什么是当世一位顶天立地的奇男子。但她压根瞧不起武功，甚至从心底里厌憎武功。因为，她父亲是被武人害死的，起因是在于一把刀；又因为，她嫁了一个不理会自己心事的男人，起因竟是在于这男人用武功救了自己。

    她一生中曾有一段短短的时光，对武功感到了一点兴趣，那是丈夫的一个朋友来作客的时候，就是这个英俊潇洒的李丰粮。他没一句话不讨人欢喜，没一个眼色不是软绵绵的叫人想起了就会心跳。但奇怪得很，丈夫对这位李董却不大瞧得起，对他爱理不理的，招待客人的事就落在她身上。
content_en:
Qin Yinghao thought of the scene of fighting against the Three Demons of Dahua, and a smile appeared on his lips. However, this was a smile in the midst of sorrow, and a fleeting joy in the midst of sadness. So he thought about getting married to Fang Ling after his leg injury healed. The unforgettable and loving wife would be the beautiful woman in front of him. She was only five feet in front of him, but these five feet were farther than five thousand miles or fifty thousand miles.

    Then he thought of the happy days after their wedding. He took his beloved wife to pay homage to Min Enchou and Fan Zhiyue. When he saw that the damage to the tomb had been repaired, he sealed the dragon bird sword in the ground in front of the tomb, thinking: "In this world, Except for Min Enchou, no one is worthy of using this sword. He is no longer in the world, so the sword should be with him. If he were still in the world, I would give it to him, and then drink with him until he is drunk. "

    In front of Min Enchou's grave, he told his wife the story of the competition and accidental injury. He never liked to talk much, but he talked endlessly on this day. This matter had been brewing in his heart for ten years, and it was only today that he vented it out in front of the people closest to him. He made a lot of wine and food to commemorate Min's grudges, and filled the table, just like Mrs. Min had made a table of food during their martial arts competition.

    So he drank a lot of wine, as if the only confidant in his life had come to life, chatting and drinking with him. The more he drank, the more he talked. He talked about how to defeat the Three Ghosts of Dahua with the Beidou Sword Technique, from the sword technique to the admiration and admiration for the Min Sword King, about the fate of the people, the impermanence of the world, and about Mrs. Min's love for her husband. He said: "For a woman like this, if her husband is in the water, she must also be in the water, and if her husband is in the fire, she will also be in the fire..."

    Suddenly, he saw his wife's face changed, and she ran away with her face covered... He chased after him and wanted to explain, but he was drunk and couldn't speak. What's more, he did remember the scene of the three ghost fire attack in the hotel... He was in the fire, but she escaped alone first...

    He was generous and heroic all his life and never paid attention to small details. However, this was the person he loved life and death... In his mind, he always felt that Fang Ling should escape. She was a woman and did not know any martial arts. She was naturally afraid of smoke and fire. She was not his wife at that time. What good would it do to die with him? But in his heart, he deeply hoped that when he was in danger, his beloved would be by his side, and that his beloved would not abandon him and run away first... He had always envied Min Enchou for having a wife who truly loved him, but he did not have one. Although Min Enchou died early, his life was happier than his own.

    After being drunk, he accidentally said the wrong sentence in front of Min Enqiu's tomb, which can also be said to have revealed his sincerity unintentionally. This sentence caused a rift between husband and wife that can never be repaired. Although, Qin Yinghao always loved his wife very deeply and sincerely.

    He would never mention this matter again, not even Min Enchou's name, and Fang Ling would naturally not mention it either.

    Later, daughter Qin Jiayin was born, as beautiful and delicate as her mother, and the relationship between husband and wife deepened. However, he was a hero from a rough background, and his wife was a daughter of a wealthy family. He is taciturn by nature and keeps a straight face all day long, but his wife needs gentle, considerate and humble comfort. She wants a man who is elegant and gentle, who understands women's little quirks, and who can joke and flirt... Qin Yinghao has the martial arts skills to defeat unrivaled opponents in the world, but he doesn't have everything his wife wants. If Fang Ling knew martial arts and had a little bit of heroic spirit, she might admire her husband's ability and understand why he is an indomitable and extraordinary man in this world. But she looked down on martial arts at all, and even hated martial arts from the bottom of her heart. Because her father was killed by a martial artist, and the cause was a knife; and because she married a man who ignored her concerns, the cause was actually that the man saved her with martial arts.

    There was a short period of time in her life when she felt a little interested in martial arts. That was when a friend of her husband came to visit, and it was this handsome and unrestrained Li Fengliang. There isn't a word he says that doesn't please people, and there isn't a look in his eyes that isn't so soft that it makes people's hearts beat when they think of it. But strangely enough, her husband did not think highly of Director Li and ignored him, so it was her responsibility to entertain the guests.
